purpose: Reserve independent, source-grounded defects for calibration of the scoring instrument only. These cases are not part of the frozen historical pilot or confirmatory experiment.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: independently reproduced revision recorded in the existing regression workflow
candidates.defect_summary: Oversized TAR PAX metadata could consume excessive memory through streaming and file-based TAR readers.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: The shared PAX parsing path did not enforce a configurable size limit before accumulating header metadata.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: Streams containing large numbers of legal empty LZ4 frames or Snappy padding chunks could overflow the stack instead of reaching EOF.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: Frame/chunk advancement recursively called the next-block parser for each zero-output unit instead of iterating.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: Wrapping PassiveExpiringMap in Collections.synchronizedMap allowed expired entries to remain visible through cached collection views and could leave the expiration index stale after iterator removal.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: Decorator-provided cached views bypassed expiration cleanup side effects implemented by PassiveExpiringMap's view methods.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: TransformedMultiValuedMap.putAll throws NullPointerException when its optional value transformer is null even though put treats null as no conversion.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: The bulk insertion path unconditionally passed a null transformer into FluentIterable/IterableUtils transformation instead of following the null-safe single-value path.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: MethodUtils.invokeMethod could throw IllegalAccessException for an instance of a non-public class even when a suitable public interface declaration exists.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: An exact-signature fast path returned the receiver class's method without the accessibility-resolution step used by the normal search path.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: GitIdentifiers could produce a tree identifier different from git write-tree for certain Unicode filenames.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: DirectoryEntry.compareTo sorted Java UTF-16 code units rather than comparing the unsigned UTF-8 bytes used by Git's tree ordering.

candidates.pre_fix_revision_derivation: first parent of the merge/fix commit; reproduction remains pending
candidates.defect_summary: RandomStringUtils.nextGraph and nextPrint did not generate tilde even though the documented character set includes it.
candidates.provisional_root_cause: The exclusive upper-bound argument was set to 126 instead of 127, making the documented 0x7E endpoint unreachable.
